page_title: Write.Homes - Transform Real Estate Listings into Marketing Magic Instantly

sources.entry: Write.homes - The ultimate real estate content creation tool #free

summary.name: Write.Homes
summary.one_liner: AI marketing tool that turns an MLS listing URL, MLS ID, or address into listing copy, social captions, email blasts, and flyers for real estate agents.
use_cases: Writing listing descriptions from an MLS link
Creating social media posts for new listings
Drafting email blasts for new properties
Tracking which posts drive views and appointments
summary.what_it_does: Write.Homes takes an MLS ID, property URL, address, or property notes and pulls in the property details automatically. It produces listing copy, social captions, email blasts, and flyers from that data. The page describes broker templates, compliance guardrails, fair-housing-safe language, and locked brand styles meant to keep output on-brand. It also claims tracking of property page views, email engagement, social analytics, and lead attribution across channels. A free listing generator is offered for trying the output.
notable: Turns an MLS URL, MLS ID, or address into multiple marketing assets
Fair-housing-aware copy and locked brand styles
Tracks lead attribution down to individual posts
Team and brokerage templates and compliance controls
caveats: Offers a 14-day free trial after which paid plans are implied; pricing details are not on the page
Community membership and workshops are mentioned but their terms are not specified
